ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 95 percent of the visible surface area compared to low-intensity black pixels confined to the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central area consists of a uniform high-intensity white field; dark-intensity pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips and along the upper trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 35-40 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge; includes a significant irregular indentation on the inner-right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distinct dark-tone pixel clusters localized at the far-left and far-right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single dark vertical linear feature visible on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch or missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high overall pixel intensity across the fluke surface with minimal internal mottled variations.
